name: 79035 · Friona, TX
findings: ZIP 79035 (Friona) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79035 (Friona) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 79035 (Friona) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
